From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -0000
Subject: Ignite23: attendee pack + priority claim flow

Team —

Thanks for supporting the Ignite23 workshop yesterday. I've attached the attendee export and a 1-pager hotlist. Quick context and asks: 

- We had ~320 registrants, 184 attendees. The attached CSV includes lead score, company, role, and notes from the session. The hotlist is our top 18 (engaged + exec title + product-fit).
- Please claim leads in HubSpot within 24 hours. Priority tiers are in the claim matrix (attached): Tier A = contact within 4 hrs, Tier B = 24 hrs, Tier C = 3 days.
- For any accounts marked "Enterprise" or with deal value > $50k, loop an AE immediately and mark the ticket with HS-98765.

Attachments: ignite23-attendees.csv (CSV), ignite23-hotlist.pdf (PDF), ignite23-claim-matrix.xlsx (XLSX)

High-priority flags in the CSV: Fusion Analytics (Kara Nguyen) — flagged A+; AvA Retail (Samira Khan) — flagged A; several smaller trials flagged B/C with follow-up templates included.

Links: attendee pack + notes: https://drive.google.com/ignite23/attendee-pack 
HubSpot quick link: https://hubspot.com/deal/HS-98765

Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Sr. Field Sales, Redwood Inference

Marissa —

Good catch on Fusion. I pulled their profile in HubSpot and their billing HQ is in Boston; primary technical contact is in Amsterdam (note in CSV). Recommendation: treat Fusion as US for AE assignment but flag EU technical owners on the contact record and include them in outreach. I'll update the HubSpot account with the "EU-technical" tag and assign the AE (J. Ortega) to the deal record HS-98765.

I've also copied the enterprise outreach template into the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/ignite23/enterprise-template — file: ignite23-enterprise-template-v2.docx. Ben plans to assign the first 6 Tier A leads to the SDR queue this evening. Remaining A/B to be distributed tomorrow morning.

Ben

Perfect — thanks Ben. Two operational notes before SDRs start outreach: 

1) Fusion Analytics (Kara) is a target account; please mark as HS-98765 and escalate to AE J. Ortega immediately. Ben — can you confirm AE has accepted? If not, I'll ping AE direct.

2) AvA Retail (Samira) requested a product deep-dive; prefer SDRs book a 45-min technical demo. Marissa — please prioritize Samira as an immediate calendar touch (Tier A).

3) For the rest: SDRs should use the enterprise template for Tier A and the event-follower template for B/C. If anyone hits a security/compliance question on call, loop SigOps (sigops@redwood.ai) and CC me.

I'm going to send a short Slack to AE and CS to make sure we're aligned. Nice work team — let's hit the 48-hr SLA on initial contact.

Sergio
